brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the effects of bile acid and bile acids sequestrants on GLP-1 Secretion, during a meal, in patients after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass.
brief_title: Effects of Bile Acids and Bile Acid Sequestrants on GLP-1 Secretion After Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Uncomplicated RYGB performed minimum 3 months prior to the study.
* Fasting plasma glucose \< 7,0 mM, HbA1c \< 48 mmol/mol 3 months after RYGB

Exclusion Criteria:

* Fasting plasma glucose \> 7,0 mM, HbA1c \> 48 mmol/mol 3 months after RYGB.
* Dysregulated thyroid diseases, use of antithyroid treatment.
* Late diabetic complications as retinopathy, renal insufficiency, neuropathy or previous pancreatitis.
* Complications to RYGB. Documented reactive hypoglycaemia, severe dumping (vomiting, diarrhea, severe abdominal pain after food intake).
* Cholecystectomy

official_title: Effects of Chenodeoxycholic Acid and Colesevelam on GLP-1 Secretion, During a Meal, After Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass
